outcome: Proportion of births to women with obesity
Proportion of births to women with normal weight
cohort: The study included 710,364 births with maternal BMI records from women who gave birth in seventeen Victorian Department of Health areas between 2010 and 2019.
finding: The proportion of births to Victorian women with obesity increased from 19.6% in 2010 to 21.5% in 2019, with a greater rise observed in regional areas and among women of lower socio-economic standing.
